prose: The Wall Street Journal interviews Ciena CEO Gary Smith, a veteran of the 2001 telecoms crash, about navigating the AI infrastructure boom. Smith says demand for Ciena's optical networking chips is outpacing supply as AI data-center build-out accelerates. The full interview is behind the Journal's bot protection.
highlights: Ciena CEO Gary Smith tells the WSJ that AI-driven demand for optical networking chips is outpacing supply.
Smith previously led Ciena through the 2001 telecoms crash, framing his caution and perspective on the AI boom.
Interview details beyond the summary are unavailable here.
